notes: Single panel. Streets: W. 8th (80') across the top; State Av. (60') diagonal down the left side, west face partly off the left edge in the south; Depot (50') from 8th to Price only; Price (20' as drawn and printed) from State to the 15' alley at x about 4900; Hatmaker (60'), Staebler (40'), Storrs (50') and St. Michael (50') from State to Burns; Neave (50') from Staebler south past St. Michael; Church (no width printed, about 49 ft drawn) only south of St. Michael at the bottom edge. Burns runs along the C.H.&D. railroad from 8th to the bottom edge; north of about Hatmaker it is a diagonal 35' street with no drawn east face (railroad side), south of that a straight 45' street. All side streets are T at State: sheets 461 and 466 show State's west face unbroken opposite Price, Hatmaker, Staebler, Storrs and St. Michael. 'St. Michael' is the saint's name (not expanded). Sheet 461 spells Staebler 'STREBLER'. Elevations in circles (63'-90') are grades, not widths.
